en-GB.help.component.properties: Shows the volume, mass, centre of mass and moments of inertia of a component, using its bodies' materials. Use it to check weight and balance of an assembly.
en-GB.help.construct.axis.through_cylinder: Creates a construction axis through the centre of a cylinder, cone or torus face, or a circular edge. Use it to turn or pattern features around a round part.
en-GB.help.construct.point.center: Creates a construction point at the centre of a circular edge, sketch circle or arc, sphere or torus. Use it as a reference for holes, axes and joints.
en-GB.help.explode.create: Creates an exploded view that pushes the parts away from the assembly's centre, or by the moves you set. Use it to show how an assembly goes together, for instructions or presentations.
en-GB.help.inspect.accessibility: Colours the faces a tool can reach from one direction, and those it cannot. Use it to check a part for machining or moulding from that side.
en-GB.help.inspect.center_of_mass: Shows the centre of mass of bodies, each on its own and all together, at uniform density. Use it to check balance and where a part will tip.
en-GB.help.inspect.colored_components: Gives each component its own temporary colour, without changing appearances. Use it to tell the parts of an assembly apart at a glance.
en-GB.help.inspect.curvature_map: Colours faces by how strongly they curve, red where the radius is small. Use it to find tight spots and to judge how smooth a surface is.
en-GB.help.inspect.draft: Colours faces by their draft angle to a pull direction, marking those with too little. Use it to check a part before moulding or casting.
en-GB.help.joint.origin: Places a named joint origin on a part: at the centre of a face or round end, the middle of an edge, a corner or a point. Use it to prepare where joints attach; one picked on a face follows it when the part changes size.
en-GB.help.parts.library: Opens the standard parts: screws, bolts, nuts, washers, set screws, dowel pins and bearings in standard sizes. Use it to add a standard part instead of modelling it yourself.
en-GB.help.sketch.arc.center_point: Draws a circular arc around a centre point, from a start point to an end point. Use it when the arc's centre is known, such as a radius around a hole or a pivot.
en-GB.help.sketch.arc.three_point: Draws an arc from a start point to an end point through a third point. Use it when the arc has to pass through given points rather than around a known centre.
en-GB.help.sketch.circle.center: Draws a circle from its centre and its diameter. Use it for holes, bosses and other round features whose centre is known.
en-GB.help.sketch.circle.two_point: Draws a circle from the two ends of its diameter. Use it when the circle's edge points are known rather than its centre.
en-GB.help.sketch.constraint.concentric: Gives two circles or arcs the same centre, or centres a circle or arc on a sketch point, including the origin. Pick either pair in either order.
en-GB.help.sketch.constraint.midpoint: Puts a point on the middle of a line, or makes the midpoints of two lines meet. Use it to centre geometry on an edge.
en-GB.help.sketch.ellipse: Draws an ellipse from its centre, the end of its major axis and a point on its minor side. Use it for oval openings, cams and other elongated round shapes.
en-GB.help.sketch.line.midpoint: Draws a line from its midpoint out to one end, with the other end mirrored. Use it for lines centred on a point, such as a symmetric edge.
en-GB.help.sketch.pattern.circular: Copies sketch geometry around a centre point, over a full circle or a set angle. Use it for bolt circles, spokes and teeth.
en-GB.help.sketch.point: Places a sketch point. Use it as a reference for dimensions, constraints, hole centres or later features.
en-GB.help.sketch.polygon.circumscribed: Draws a regular polygon around a circle, sized from its centre to the middle of a side. Use it when the width across flats is known, as for a hex nut.
en-GB.help.sketch.polygon.inscribed: Draws a regular polygon inside a circle, sized from its centre to a corner. Use it when the size across corners is known.
en-GB.help.sketch.rectangle.center: Draws a rectangle from its centre and one corner. Use it for outlines centred on a point, such as the origin.
en-GB.help.sketch.slot.arc_center: Draws a curved slot of a given width along an arc set by its centre, start and end. Use it for adjustment slots around a pivot.
en-GB.help.sketch.slot.center_point: Draws a straight slot of a given width from its centre to the centre of one end arc. Use it for slots centred on a point.
en-GB.help.sketch.slot.center_to_center: Draws a straight slot of a given width between the centres of its two end arcs. Use it for slots dimensioned centre to centre, such as adjustment slots for screws.
en-GB.help.sketch.transform: Scales, turns and moves sketch geometry about a centre point in one step. Use it to reposition and resize a selection at once.
en-GB.help.solid.box: Creates a box from a length, width and height, from a corner point or centred on a point. Use it for a quick block, a placeholder or a body to cut features into.
en-GB.help.solid.sphere: Creates a sphere from a radius or diameter around a centre point. Use it for balls, knobs and rounded ends.
en-GB.help.view.grid: Shows or hides the grid in the viewport. Use it as a size and orientation guide while modelling.
en-GB.prefs.navigator_fit_note: A face, corner or arrow of the view cube, or an axis of the gizmo, also looks at the middle of the model from the one distance that fits it from every side (its bounding sphere). Home uses the same zoom and centre while this is on, so views chosen after it only turn. Off: the view turns in place, keeping its target and zoom.
en-GB.prefs.preview_tint_new_faces_help: A preview of a feature that changes a body can draw the surface it adds in the preview colour. When off, the body is drawn as itself.
en-GB.prefs.sketch.ellipse_axes_note: The major and minor axes as construction lines, so the half-axes and axes can be dimensioned. Off: the ellipse alone, and D on it gives its minor radius wherever the value is pulled, drawn and labelled R as before.
en-GB.prefs.viewport_analysis_status_help: Show active analyses above the viewport, open their legends from each item, and use Esc to turn off the newest analysis. Turn off to restore corner legends and the previous Esc behaviour.
en-GB.refused.face_curved: One of its curved faces can't be used for modelling.
en-GB.refused.face_flat: One of its flat faces can't be used for modelling.
en-GB.refused.face_freeform: One of its freeform faces can't be used for modelling.
en-GB.refused.face_rounded: One of its rounded faces can't be used for modelling.
en-GB.refused.faces_apart: Its faces don't meet closely enough to be used for modelling.
en-GB.ui.construction.side_hint: Construction line: click the side the line runs towards; right-click to restart
